statement: For all sufficiently large primes p, uniformly in l ≥ 1, define Ml,p = ∑︂ S⊆[w] |S|≤t+1 p−|S|δ/2 νl,p,S, µl,p = Ml,p Ml,p(1) , 17 εl,p = 1 Ml,p(1) ∑︂ |S|=t+1 p−(t+1)δ/2 νl,p,S. Then µl,p is a reflection-positive probability law and 0 ≤ εl,p ≤ µl,p. Its exceptional mass satisfies ηl,p := εl,p(1) ≤ p−4 . The probability law µ◦ l,p = µl,p − εl,p 1 − ηl,p has only admissible increments zvj+1 − zvj along the designated cycle. Every component and both measures µl,p, εl,p are invariant under simultaneous translation of all labels. Every positive-mass component or subsum therefore has uniform single-slot marginals after normalization. In either µl,p or µ◦ l,p, the total probability of components with S ̸= ∅ is O(p−δ/2).
